name: playtest4

name: firststeps

name: playtest5
what: transit lines survive a street joining their road; bulldoze names the line; transit list refreshes; per-ride costs; green "Built" after placing; valid-site rings; save on page hide

name: carsolid
what: (fails in most runs on one residual: two cars from the two lanes of the block's road 44 overlapping as they enter the box side by side; lanes are clean) cars never drawn inside each other in a lane or a junction at morning rush, no car stuck off a red, no heading snaps; steps the traffic model without rendering

name: junctionmouth
what: (no browser) junction shapes: mouth areas per class pair and angle, the cars' clearance to the kerb, paint against stopped cars; --compare old.json proves the network (nodes, segments, trims, junction curves) did not move

name: junctionedit
what: rebuilds a junction every way the game does (build across, upgrade, flip, bulldoze arm by arm, the Freedom Circle) and checks meshes stay finite and trims stay the network's

name: crosswalktest
what: people and cars at crosswalks: nobody on foot inside a car, people cross junction arms and wait at the kerb for a gap or the walk phase, cars stop for them, and stopping costs under a tenth of the traffic

name: parkingtest
what: live parking and drive-thru lines: lots fill by the hour (offices mid-morning, shops at noon, empty at 3 am), cars pull into stalls and every trip leaving a lot with a car its length in it backs out of a stall, a grand opening spills the drive-thru line onto the road and it clears (a block with no drive-thru gets one on a stroad shop lot, and the lot must get its lane); parked cars, frame time and calls per preset with and without

name: landmarktest
what: landmarks draw visitors: sightseers by day, a game-night crowd at Slop 69 Field (every evening, 5 to 10 pm) that leaves home by its drive, two in three in their seats by kickoff, fills its lot and drives home after; the inspector counts today's visitors; a landmark no road reaches draws nobody (SEED)

name: gridlocktest
what: a Florida county the bot grew to 2,800 people (shots/florida2800.json, grown once if missing), the same seed with this round's truck courtesy and gridlock breaker and without, 120 days at ▶▶▶: more goods delivered by truck, traffic still moves; then a 30-minute ▶▶▶ soak (cars only): far fewer moments with a ring of lanes each waiting on the next, and no lane standing still for good (SEED, TOWN, DAYS, SOAK)

name: lightstest
what: actuated lights: at the evening rush, the same seed with fixed 11 s greens, actuated without leading greens, and both (a green nobody waits for goes to its yellow when someone waits on another; a left first at its line gets its road's green ahead of the oncoming one): a fifth more cars through the light whose fixed greens stand idle longest while its queues wait a whole cycle, no fewer through all the lights, the leading greens cost all the lights a tenth of their cars at most and, where a dozen lefts queue a cycle at a light (the one with the most), cut their wait by a third at least (else reported as skipped, with the numbers), people on foot wait no longer, no two phases inside each other in the box at any light (SEED, NODE, LEFT_NODE, SECONDS, HOUR)

name: walklinetest
what: one walk line (roadJunction.ts armCrossing): every arm people cross has a zebra under their logged path, no zebra where nobody may cross, nobody walks over an arm's lanes off its crossing, a car waiting at its line keeps 2 m short of where people walk over its lane (SEED, SECONDS)

name: botclinics
what: the late-game bot (scripts/lib/latePlayer.mjs) grows a county from nothing, seeded, and relieves an overloaded clinic with a hospital once it can afford one, before that a clinic on the lot that takes most of its load (services.ts takeFrom): no more clinics than one per 1,200 people and two, every one serving a fifth of its room at least; prints how long clinics were overloaded (MAP, POP, DAYS, SEED)

name: trashcliff
what: the trash cliff: the reference block with its landfills bulldozed, day by day: abandoned buildings stand 90 days, an alert says how many come down and when 30 and 7 days ahead, the inspector says when (SEED, DAYS)

name: demandwords
what: (no browser) the demand card's reasons read right at 1: no count goes straight before a plural in sim.ts's demand parts or services.ts's utilities hit

name: collegetest

name: trafficscale

why: a measurement over its target today (the traffic pass owns it)

name: gridtest
what: Roads > Grid: three clicks lay a street grid (junctions, lots, price, red streets left out, one-ways alternate, one undo, touch)

name: undotest

name: progression

name: weathertest

name: costtest

name: playtest6-late

A measuring tool (CHECK=1 makes it a gate), not part of the default pass

name: presstest

name: presslook
what: phone (a finger held down) and desktop (the mouse held down): a toolbar button, a speed button, the population stat, a drawer's chip and card, a More tile, the tool badge and the inspector's Bulldoze are brighter while pressed, the plain buttons a little smaller, and brighter under a mouse; a locked card answers nothing; each press is let go off the control, so nothing is clicked

name: servicelooks
what: phone and desktop, once the vault's pack has loaded: the Services drawer has no Looks row; Settings has the two looks (Asset Vault, Classic), finger-sized on the phone, the one in use lit; Classic puts a standing fire station in its classic model at once and is remembered, and Asset Vault puts it back, the same building both times

name: busfollow

name: statstest
what: phone and desktop, a county grown for 70 days: Statistics under More opens four charts (population, treasury, nature and sprawl, moved in and left), each drawn from the simulation's rows and headed by today's figure; a pointer across the population chart reads the day under it; ten days on the open charts have moved on; nothing spills and no text is under 12 px (--shots saves pictures)

name: busridetest

name: sheettool

name: soundhooks

name: weekstest
